<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">Fiscal
2020 Acquisitions</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">On
October 10, 2019, we purchased a newly constructed <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--PurchaseOfIndustrialBuilding_iI_pii_uSqFoot_c20191010__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AmazoncomServicesIncMember_zFY2ccJUXvRj" title="Purchase of industrial building"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PurchaseOfIndustrialBuilding" contextRef="AsOf2019-10-10_custom_AmazoncomServicesIncMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="SqFoot">616,000</ix:nonFraction></span> square foot industrial building, situated on <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--PurchaseOfOverallIndustrialBuilding_iI_pii_uAcres_c20191010__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AmazoncomServicesIncMember_zklLMb8i6Bab" title="Purchase of overall industrial building"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PurchaseOfOverallIndustrialBuilding" contextRef="AsOf2019-10-10_custom_AmazoncomServicesIncMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Acres">78.6</ix:nonFraction></span> acres, located in
the Indianapolis, IN Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA). The building is <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--PercentageOfRealEstatePropertyLeased_pii_dp_uPure_c20191009__20191010__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AmazoncomServicesIncMember_zmSyUVc9Mejl" title="Percentage of real estate property leased"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PercentageOfRealEstatePropertyLeased" contextRef="From2019-10-092019-10-10_custom_AmazoncomServicesIncMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">100</ix:nonFraction></span>% net-leased to a subsidiary of Amazon.com Services,
Inc. (Amazon) for <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--LeaseTerm_dtY_c20191009__20191010__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AmazoncomServicesIncMember_zk0AXGTFVPMk" title="Lease term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-10-092019-10-10_custom_AmazoncomServicesIncMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="mnr:LeaseTerm">15</ix:nonNumeric></span> years through <span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--LeaseExpirationDates_c20191009__20191010__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--AmazoncomServicesIncMember" title="Lease expiration date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-10-092019-10-10_custom_AmazoncomServicesIncMember" name="mnr:LeaseExpirationDates">August 2034</ix:nonNumeric></span>. The lease is guaranteed by Amazon. forma information (unaudited)</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
following unaudited pro forma condensed financial information has been prepared utilizing our historical financial statements
and from the properties acquired and expanded during fiscal years 2020 and 2019, assuming that these acquisitions and these completed
expansions had occurred as of October 1, 2018, after giving effect to certain adjustments including: (a) Rental Revenue adjustments
resulting from the straight-lining of scheduled rent increases, (b) Interest Expense resulting from the assumed increase in Fixed
Rate Mortgage Notes Payable and Loans Payable related to the new acquisitions, and (c) Depreciation Expense related to the new
acquisitions and expansions. Furthermore, the net proceeds raised from our Dividend Reinvestment and Stock Purchase Plan (the
DRIP) were used to fund property acquisitions and expansions and therefore, the weighted average shares outstanding used in calculating
the pro-forma Basic and Diluted Net Income (Loss) per Share Attributable to Common Shareholders has been adjusted to account for
the increase in shares raised through the DRIP, as if all the shares raised had occurred on October 1, 2018. Additionally, the
net proceeds raised from the issuance of our 6.125% Series C Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, $0.01 par value per share
(6.125% Series C Preferred Stock), through our At-The-Mark Sales Agreement Program were used to help fund property acquisitions
and, therefore, the pro-forma preferred dividend has been adjusted to account for its effect on pro-forma Net Income (Loss) Attributable
to Common Shareholders as if all the preferred stock issuances had occurred on October 1, 2018.</span></p>

We intend to limit the size of this portfolio to no more than approximately
<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--PercentageOfUndepreciatedAssetsInvestmentMarketableSecurities_pii_dp_uPure_c20191001__20200930_zyxshPjjwGai" title="Security available for sale, maximum percentage of investment on undepreciated assets"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PercentageOfUndepreciatedAssetsInvestmentMarketableSecurities" contextRef="From2019-10-01to2020-09-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">5</ix:nonFraction></span>% of our undepreciated assets, which we define as total assets excluding accumulated depreciation. We continue to believe that
our REIT securities portfolio provides us with diversification, income, a source of potential liquidity when needed and also serves
as a proxy for real estate when more favorable risk adjusted returns are not available in the private real estate markets. Our
decision to reduce this threshold mainly stems from the implementation of accounting rule ASU 2016-01, &#8220;Financial Instruments
&#8211; Overall: Recognition and Measurement of Financial Assets and Financial Liabilities&#8221;, which took effect at the beginning
of last fiscal year. This new rule requires that quarterly changes in the market value of our marketable securities flow through
our Consolidated Statements of Income (Loss). The implementation of this accounting rule has resulted in increased volatility
in our reported earnings and some of our key performance metrics. <p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">We
normally hold REIT securities long-term and have the ability and intent to hold these securities to recovery. We have determined
that none of our security holdings are other than temporarily impaired and therefore all unrealized gains and losses from these
securities have been recognized as Unrealized Holding Gains (Losses) Arising During the Periods in our Consolidated Statements
of Income (Loss). If we were to determine any of our securities to be other than temporarily impaired, we would present these
unrealized holding losses as an impairment charge in our Consolidated Statements of Income (Loss).</span></p>

in an interest rate of <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1_pii_dp_uPure_c20191113__20191115__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__custom--NewRevolverMember_zoMSJOxtBSHf" title="Current interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" contextRef="From2019-11-132019-11-15_custom_NewRevolverMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.61</ix:nonFraction></span>%. As of the fiscal yearend and currently, we do not have any amount drawn down under our Revolver,
resulting in the full $225.0 million being currently available. The $75.0 million Term Loan matures <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--DebtInstrumentMaturityDates_c20191113__20191115__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TermLoanMember_zDCyuWGop9yh"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-11-132019-11-15_custom_TermLoanMember" name="mnr:DebtInstrumentMaturityDates">January 2025</ix:nonNumeric></span>. <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--DebtInstrumentInterestRateDescription_c20191113__20191115__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TermLoanMember"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-11-132019-11-15_custom_TermLoanMember" name="mnr:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDescription">The interest
rate for borrowings under the Term Loan will at our election, either i) bear interest at LIBOR plus 130 basis points to 200 basis
points, depending on our leverage ratio, or ii) bear interest at BMO&#8217;s prime lending rate plus 30 basis points to 100 basis
points, depending on our leverage ratio. To reduce floating interest rate exposure under the Term Loan, we also entered into an
interest rate swap agreement to fix LIBOR on the entire $75.0 million for the full duration of the Term Loan</ix:nonNumeric></span> resulting in an all-in
rate of <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pii_dp_uPure_c20191115__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TermLoanMember_zSf9kQKe3bv8" title="Current interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2019-11-15_custom_TermLoanMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">2.92</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">Margin
Loans</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

time to time we use a margin loan for purchasing securities, for temporary funding of acquisitions, and for working capital purposes.
This loan is due on demand and is collateralized by our securities portfolio. We must maintain a coverage ratio of approximately
<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--PercentageOfAmountAvailableToBorrowOnMargin_iI_pii_dp_uPure_c20200930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--MarginLoansMember_zV1BfrLDcjn6" title="Percentage of amount available to borrow on margin"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PercentageOfAmountAvailableToBorrowOnMargin" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30_custom_MarginLoansMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>%. 2020 and 2019, respectively, and is currently <span id="xdx_900_ecustom--PercentageOfAmountAvailableToBorrowOnMarginCurrentInterestRate_iI_dp_uPure_c20200930__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--MarginLoansMember_zdLsAKKLyCv4" title="Current interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PercentageOfAmountAvailableToBorrowOnMarginCurrentInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30_custom_MarginLoansMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.75</ix:nonFraction></span>%. 9 - <span id="xdx_82E_znQGkWXLMl7j">STOCK COMPENSATION PLAN</span></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">At
our Annual Meeting held on May 18, 2017, our common shareholders approved our Amended and Restated 2007 Incentive Award Plan (the
Plan) which extended the term of our 2007 Incentive Award Plan for an additional <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--ExtendTermOfPlan_dtY_c20170517__20170518__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember_z9TKnmPvC5ff" title="Extend the term of plan"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2017-05-172017-05-18_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="mnr:ExtendTermOfPlan">10</ix:nonNumeric></span> years, until March 13, 2027, added <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_pin6_c20170518__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember_zLWUuaE47Ks3" title="Common stock shares reserved for future issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2017-05-18_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">1.6</ix:nonFraction></span> million
shares of common stock to the share reserve, expanded the types of awards available for grant under the Plan and made other improvements
to the 2007 Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Compensation Committee, in its capacity as Plan Administrator, shall determine, among other things: the recipients of awards;
the type and number of awards participants will receive; the terms, conditions and forms of the awards; the times and conditions
subject to which awards may be exercised or become vested, deliverable or exercisable, or as to which any restrictions may apply
or lapse; and may amend or modify the terms and conditions of an award, except that repricing of options or Stock Appreciation
Rights (SAR) is not permitted without shareholder approval.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardTermsOfAward_c20191001__20200930__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" title="Stock based awards description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardTermsOfAward">No
participant may receive awards during any calendar year covering more than 200,000 shares of common stock or more than $1.5 million
in cash</ix:nonNumeric></span>. Regular annual awards granted to non-employee directors as compensation for services as non-employee directors during
any fiscal year may not exceed $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationGross_c20191001__20200930__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--NonEmployeeDirectorsMember_pp0p0" title="Maximum share based compensation award granted in value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationGross" contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_NonEmployeeDirectorsMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" scale="0" unitRef="USD">100,000</ix:nonFraction></span> in value on the date of grant, and the grant date value of any special or one-time award
upon election or appointment to the Board of Directors may not exceed $<span id="xdx_904_ecustom--OnetimeMaximumShareBasedCompensationAwardGrantedUponElectionInValue_c20191001__20200930__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--NonEmployeeDirectorsMember_pp0p0" title="One-time maximum share based compensation award granted upon election in value"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:OnetimeMaximumShareBasedCompensationAwardGrantedUponElectionInValue" contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_NonEmployeeDirectorsMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" scale="0" unitRef="USD">200,000</ix:nonFraction></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Awards
granted pursuant to the Plan generally may not vest until the first anniversary of the date the award was granted, provided, however,
that up to <span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--PercentageOfCommonSharesAvailableUnderPlanWithoutMinimumVestingPeriod_pii_dp_uPure_c20191001__20200930__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember_zMhrjvZzOJP2" title="Percentage of common shares available under plan without minimum vesting period"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:PercentageOfCommonSharesAvailableUnderPlanWithoutMinimumVestingPeriod" contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">5</ix:nonFraction>%</span> of the Common Shares available under the Plan may be awarded to any one or more Eligible Individuals without the
minimum vesting period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">If
an award made under the Plan is forfeited, expires or is converted into shares of another entity in connection with a recapitalization,
reorganization, merger, consolidation, split-up, spin-off, combination, exchange of shares or other similar event, or the award
is settled in cash, the shares associated with the forfeited, expired, converted or settled award will become available for additional
awards under the Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
term of any stock option or SAR generally may not be more than <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod_dtY_c20191001__20200930__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember_zpGgpw5MPi66" title="Stock option term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod">10</ix:nonNumeric></span> years from the date of grant. The exercise price per common
share under the Plan generally may not be below <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--ExercisePricePerCommonSharePercentage_pii_dp_uPure_c20191001__20200930__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember_zheJgMjGxUId" title="Exercise price per common share percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:ExercisePricePerCommonSharePercentage" contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_custom_AmendedAndRestatedTwoThousandSevenIncentiveAwardPlanMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">100</ix:nonFraction>%</span> of the fair market value of a common share at the date of grant.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">We
account for our stock options and restricted stock in accordance with ASC 718-10, Compensation-Stock Compensation. ASC 718-10
requires that compensation cost for all stock awards be calculated and amortized over the service period (generally equal to the
vesting period).</span></p>

12 - <span id="xdx_82E_zaz3VUS07p7i">TAXES</span></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Income
Tax</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">We
have elected to be taxed as a REIT under the applicable provisions of the Code under Sections 856 to 860 and the comparable New
Jersey Statutes. Under such provisions, we will not be taxed on that portion of our taxable income distributed currently to shareholders,
provided that at least <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--DividendRequirementForEstimatedTaxableIncome_pii_dp_uPure_c20191001__20200930_ztuOMdA94mml" title="Required distribution to be exempt from taxable income"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:DividendRequirementForEstimatedTaxableIncome" contextRef="From2019-10-01to2020-09-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">90</ix:nonFraction>%</span> of our taxable income is distributed. As we have and intend to continue to distribute all of our income,
currently no provision has been made for income taxes. If we fail to qualify as a REIT in any taxable year, we will be subject
to federal income taxes at regular corporate rates and may not be able to qualify as a REIT for four subsequent taxable years.
Even if we qualify for taxation as a REIT, we may be subject to certain state and local taxes on our income and property, and
to federal income and excise taxes on our undistributed taxable income. In addition, taxable income from non-REIT activities managed
through taxable REIT subsidiaries is subject to federal, state, and local income taxes.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Federal
Excise Tax</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">We
do not have a Federal excise tax liability for the calendar years 2020, 2019 and 2018, since we intend to or have distributed
all of our annual Federal taxable net income.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A6_z49eEvj1q3Gi" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
annual dividend of the 6.125% Series C Preferred Stock is $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared_pii_c20191001__20200930__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesCPreferredStockMember_z1XSIZEJ4fFb" title="Annual rate of dividends cumulative and payable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared" contextRef="From2019-10-012020-09-30_us-gaap_SeriesCPreferredStockMember59283734" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.53125</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, or 6.125% of the $25.00 per share liquidation value
and is payable quarterly in arrears on March 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15. The 6.125% Series C Preferred Stock has
no maturity and will remain outstanding indefinitely unless redeemed or otherwise repurchased. Except in limited circumstances
relating to our qualification as a REIT, and as described below, the 6.125% Series C Preferred Stock is not redeemable prior to
September 15, 2021. On and after September 15, 2021, at any time and, from time to time, the <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--DividendRateInPercentageOfPreferredStock_iI_pii_dp_uPure_c20200930__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesCCumulativeRedeemablePreferredStockMember__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--OnandAfterSeptemberFifteenTwoThousandTwentyOneMember_z2WPoDaqcEKk" title="Cumulative redeemable preferred, stock dividend rate"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:DividendRateInPercentageOfPreferredStock" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30_custom_SeriesCCumulativeRedeemablePreferredStockMember_custom_OnandAfterSeptemberFifteenTwoThousandTwentyOneMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.125</ix:nonFraction></span>% Series C Preferred Stock will
be redeemable in whole, or in part, at our option, at a cash redemption price of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PreferredStockRedemptionPricePerShare_iI_pii_c20200930__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesCCumulativeRedeemablePreferredStockMember__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--OnandAfterSeptemberFifteenTwoThousandTwentyOneMember_zmoRJp2Q0ynh" title="Preferred stock redemption price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30_custom_SeriesCCumulativeRedeemablePreferredStockMember_custom_OnandAfterSeptemberFifteenTwoThousandTwentyOneMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">25.00</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, plus all accrued and unpaid

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A2_zQtyUvOLS2s1" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; letter-spacing: -0.15pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">In
addition to our investments in Securities Available for Sale at Fair Value and our interest rate swap agreement, we are required
to disclose certain information about fair values of our other financial instruments. Estimates of fair value are made at a specific
point in time based upon, where available, relevant market prices and information about the financial instrument. Such estimates
do not include any premium or discount that could result from offering for sale at one time our entire holdings of a particular
financial instrument. For a portion of our other financial instruments, no quoted market value exists. Therefore, estimates of
fair value are necessarily based on a number of significant assumptions (many of which involve events outside of our control).
Such assumptions include assessments of current economic conditions, perceived risks associated with these financial instruments
and their counterparties; future expected loss experience and other factors. Given the uncertainties surrounding these assumptions,
the reported fair values represent estimates only, and therefore cannot be compared to the historical accounting model. The use
of different assumptions or methodologies is likely to result in significantly different fair value estimates.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
fair value of Cash and Cash Equivalents approximates their current carrying amounts since all such items are short-term in nature.
The fair value of variable rate Loans Payable approximates their current carrying amounts since such amounts payable are at approximately
a weighted average current market rate of interest. The estimated fair value of fixed rate mortgage notes payable is based on
discounting the future cash flows at a year-end risk adjusted borrowing rate currently available to us for issuance of debt with
similar terms and remaining maturities. These fair value measurements fall within level 2 of the fair value hierarchy. At September
30, 2020, the fixed rate Mortgage Notes Payable fair value (estimated based upon expected cash outflows discounted at current
market rates) amounted to $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--NotesPayableFairValueDisclosure_iI_pn5n6_c20200930_zC5kbw7PoQ78" title="Fixed rate mortgage notes payable at fair value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NotesPayableFairValueDisclosure" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">861.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million and the carrying value amounted to $<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--NotesPayables_iI_pn5n6_c20200930_zV35cNmKm0xl" title="Fixed rate mortgage notes payable, carrying value"><ix:nonFraction name="mnr:NotesPayables" contextRef="AsOf2020-09-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">807.4</ix:nonFraction>
</span></span><span style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">million. When we acquired a property,
we allocate purchase price based upon relative fair value of all the assets and liabilities, including intangible assets and liabilities,
relating to the properties acquired lease (See Note 3). Those fair value measurements were estimated based on independent third-party
appraisals and fell within level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.</span></p>
